name: Knowledge bases (Foundry IQ)
summary: Foundry IQ Knowledge Base — search-service-hosted retrieval, queried from a BYOM-routed agent.
description: Foundry IQ Knowledge Bases use the Azure AI Search `POST {search-endpoint}/knowledgebases/{name}/retrieve?api-version=2026-05-01-preview` surface rather than `project.indexes`. They let agents retrieve from a managed knowledge base backed by Azure AI Search while a BYOM-routed orchestrator model would synthesize the answer.
notes:
Not yet probed against Foundry because the current environment lacks the required Knowledge Base prerequisites. Docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/foundry/agents/how-to/foundry-iq-connect.

Prerequisites are AI Search Standard SKU or higher with `semanticSearch='standard'`, semantic ranker enabled, `publicNetworkAccess='Enabled'` or a caller inside the search VNet, and a BYOM agent with a Knowledge Base retrieval tool. SDK blocker: the KB retrieve tool for Prompt Agents is not yet in `azure-ai-projects 2.3.0`; the orchestrator uses raw REST plus OBO header `x-ms-query-source-authorization`, as shown in `Azure/gpt-rag-orchestrator` `connectors/foundry_iq.py`.
